Aditya — thanks for the heads up. Quick review from finance: CP575 scanned copy is usually acceptable for new-vendor EIN verification, provided we also have either a bank letter or a voided check for ACH enrollment. The W-9 needs to show a name that matches bank account ownership to avoid 1099/ACH mismatches.

Action items for Brightstream: please confirm the bank account name and upload a voided check (or bank letter). If the signer on the W-9 is not on the bank account, we require an authorization letter (signed by the account owner) or a DocuSign W-9 where the signer clarifies capacity.

If they can upload the voided check and the CP575, finance can provision a conditional PO (PO will be issued with a note: "Pending ACH verification") so operations can begin.
